[EN] Fluxing the Capacitor
[ES] Activando el condensador
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] If you destroy the {@LinkCreature:418#2008#vendron capacitors}, that could cripple the argons.
[ES] Si destruyes los {@LinkCreature:418#2008#condensadores vendron}, podrías debilitar gravemente a los argones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You're unstoppable!
[ES] ¡Eres imparable!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can handle it."
[ES] "Puedo con esto."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to {@LinkCreature:418#2002#Tibonel} in the {@Rgn:9018001$$Argon Catacombs}.
[ES] Preséntate ante {@LinkCreature:418#2002#Tibonel} en las {@Rgn:9018001$$Argon Catacombs}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask {@LinkCreature:418#2002$$Tibonel} to open the portal. Go through and destroy the vendron capacitors in the {@Rgn:9018001$$Argon Catacombs}.
[ES] Pídele a {@LinkCreature:418#2002$$Tibonel} que abra el portal. Cruza y destruye los condensadores vendron en las {@Rgn:9018001$$Argon Catacombs}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to {@LinkCreature:418#2002#Tibonel}.
[ES] Vuelve a informarle a {@LinkCreature:418#2002#Tibonel}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
